title: James Lawson: How Young Fishers Are Changing the Game
excerpt: President of the UFAWU-Unifor and a young voice on the water, James Lawson makes the case for the next generation of fishers — and why the fishery has to work for them.

title: In the Wheelhouse with Captain Dylan Fowler: BC Ferries' Northern Expedition
excerpt: A steady hand at the helm of BC Ferries' Northern Expedition on the exposed north-coast run, where — as he puts it — a gale is just the opening argument.

title: Danni Tribe: The Sointula Mariner Ferrying High Schoolers Across Johnstone Strait
excerpt: Captain of the Spirit of Yalis, Danni Tribe carries 70-plus high-schoolers from Alert Bay across Johnstone Strait to school in Port McNeill — every day, in every weather.

title: Esther Sample: Commercial Fisher, Mom, and Artist of the BC Coast
excerpt: She can haul halibut and spring salmon with the best of them — and paint the coast she fishes. Esther Sample: commercial fisher, mom, and celebrated West Coast artist.

title: Exxon Valdez, Thirty-Seven Years Later
excerpt: “A warning from the woman who tried to clean it up.” Thirty-seven years after the Exxon Valdez, one cleanup worker's account of what an oil spill really leaves behind.
